items.title: Approve the Minutes of the December 8, 2020 Meeting
Adopt the 15 Third Bus Study Final Report
Allocate $682,600 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds and $234,005 in Prop AA Vehicle Registration Fee Funds, with Conditions, for Four Requests
Approve $1 million in Former Central Freeway Parcel Revenues for the Page Street Neighborway Project
Appropriate $550,000 in Prop K Funds for the Downtown San Francisco Congestion Pricing Study
Allocate up to $5,773,403 and Appropriate $150,000 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds, with Conditions, for Potrero Yard
Evaluate Public Employee Performance and Approve the Executive Director’s Performance Objectives for 2021
Set the Annual Compensation for the Executive Director for 2021
